# Load libraries
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(terra) # raster handling
library(stars) # raster handling
library(tmap) # map making
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(gt) # table formatting
```

# Load data
```{r}
# Load data for Feb 7, 2021 tiles (pre-storm)
tile5_7 <- read_stars("data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v05.001.2021039064328.tif")
tile6_7 <- read_stars("data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v06.001.2021039064329.tif")

# Load data for Feb 16, 2021 tiles (post-storm)
tile5_16 <- read_stars("data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v05.001.2021048091106.tif")
tile6_16 <- read_stars("data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v06.001.2021048091105.tif")

# Load data for Texas roads
highway_query <- "SELECT * FROM gis_osm_roads_free_1 WHERE fclass='motorway'"
highway <- st_read("data/gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg", query = highway_query)

# Load data for Houston area homes
homes_query <- "SELECT *
FROM gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1
WHERE (type IS NULL AND name IS NULL)
OR type in ('residential', 'apartments', 'house', 'static_caravan', 'detached')"
homes <- st_read("data/gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg", query = homes_query)
```

# Create a raster object for each day (Feb 7 and Feb 16)
```{r}
# Combine Feb 7, 2021 tiles
pre_storm <- st_mosaic(tile5_7,tile6_7)

# Combine Feb 16, 2021 tiles
post_storm <- st_mosaic(tile5_16, tile6_16)
```

# Check Coordinate Reference Systems
```{r}
# Check that pre storm and blackout raster CRSs match
if(st_crs(pre_storm) == st_crs(post_storm)) {
  print(paste('CRS match! CRS is:' , st_crs(pre_storm)))
}else{
  warning('CRS do not match')
  print(paste('pre_storm CRS is', st_crs(pre_storm)))
  print(paste('blackout CRS is', st_crs(post_storm)))
}
```

```{r}
# Check that homes and highway data vector CRSs match
if(st_crs(homes) == st_crs(highway)) {
  print(paste('CRS match! CRS is:' , st_crs(homes)))
}else{
  warning('CRS do not match')
  print(paste('Roads CRS is', st_crs(homes)))
  print(paste('Homes CRS is', st_crs(highway)))
}
```

_The light data, houses data, and roads data all use the EPSG 4326 coordinate reference system._

## Visualize Blackout
To visualize the blackout...


```{r}
# Find change in night lights intensity caused by storm
difference_blackout <- post_storm - pre_storm

blackout <- difference_blackout < -200

blackout[!blackout] <- NA

# Vectorize the blackout mask
blackout_mask <- st_as_sf(blackout) |> 
  st_make_valid()

# Define Houston area (give coordinate points as a vector)
houston_area <- st_bbox(c(xmin= -96.5, ymin = 29, xmax = -94.5, ymax = 30.5),
crs = st_crs(blackout_mask)) # plot with same CRS 

#Crop blackout raster to Houston area
blackout_crop <- st_crop(blackout_mask, houston_area)

#Re-project the blackout raster to EPSG 3083
new_blackout <- st_transform(blackout_crop, crs=st_crs(3083))
```

# Exclude highways from the cropped blackout mask
```{r}
# Transform highway CRS to new_blackout
highway <- st_transform(highway, crs=st_crs(new_blackout))
```

```{r}
# Check if CRS match
if(st_crs(new_blackout) == st_crs(highway)) {
  print(paste('CRS match! CRS is:' , st_crs(new_blackout)$epsg)) #use $ to subset epsg from st_crs output
}else{
  warning('CRS do not match')
  print(paste('Blackout CRS is', st_crs(new_blackout)))
  print(paste('Highway CRS is', st_crs(highway)))
}
```

```{r}
# Identify areas within 200m of all highways
highways_200m <- st_buffer(highway, dist = 200)

highways_200m_buffer <- st_union(highways_200m) # connects all overlapping buffers

# Find areas that experienced blackouts that are further than 200m
blackout_without_highways <- st_difference(new_blackout, highways_200m_buffer) # keep all blackouts that don't overlap with the buffer
```

# Identify the number of homes likely impacted by blackouts
```{r}
# Transform homes CRS to blackout without highways
homes <- st_transform(homes, crs=st_crs(blackout_without_highways))
```
```{r}
# Check if CRS match
if(st_crs(homes) == st_crs(blackout_without_highways)) {
  print(paste('CRS match! CRS is:' , st_crs(blackout_without_highways)$epsg)) #use $ to subset epsg from st_crs output
}else{
  warning('CRS do not match')
  print(paste('Homes CRS is', st_crs(homes)))
  print(paste('Blackout without highways is', st_crs(blackout_without_highways)))
}
```

```{r}
#Crop homes to blackout area
homes_blackout_crop <- st_crop(homes, blackout_without_highways)
```

```{r}
# Only keep homes that overlap with areas that experienced blackouts
homes_blackout <- homes_blackout_crop |> 
  st_filter(y = blackout_without_highways, .predicate = st_intersects) # subset homes that intersect with blackout highways

plot(homes_blackout)

n_homes <- nrow(homes_blackout) #Approximately 157,408 homes were affected by the February 2021 blackout
```

```{r}
# Map of Houston-area homes that lost power
tm_shape(homes_blackout) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "firebrick", col = "firebrick", lwd = 0.1) +
  tm_graticules(lwd = 0.25, alpha = 0.5, labels.size = 0.4) +
  tm_scalebar(position = tm_pos_in("left", "bottom")) +
  tm_compass(position = tm_pos_in("right", "top")) +
  tm_title("Houston Homes Without Power, Feb 16, 2021", fontface = "bold")

```
